instruction: Enable Apache mod_proxy_balancer with sticky sessions
output:
<think>
1. Task Breakdown:
   1. Prepare the systemctl configuration with the required parameters
   2. Apply the configuration and verify with `a2enmod status`
   3. Enable persistence across reboots if applicable

2. Tool Selection & Logic:
   Primary tool: `a2enmod` — a2enmod command execution and management
   Supporting tool: `systemctl` — manage systemd services and units
   Chain commands with `&&` to abort on first failure

3. Safety & Edge Cases:
   SERVICE: restart only during maintenance window; verify unit dependencies with `systemctl list-dependencies`
</think>
a2enmod proxy_balancer lbmethod_byrequests && cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/balancer.conf << 'EOF'
<Proxy balancer://mycluster>
  BalancerMember http://192.168.1.10:80 route=node1
  BalancerMember http://192.168.1.11:80 route=node2
  ProxySet stickysession=ROUTEID
</Proxy>
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ProxyPass / balancer://mycluster/
</VirtualHost>
EOF && a2ensite balancer && systemctl reload apache2
